verdict.rationale: Runway is an AI video generation platform, so directing camera moves is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item documents camera-control features such as pan, zoom, orbit or static presets, or camera-motion parameters in the API. The pack covers text/image-to-video generation, references, drafts and output formats, but none of these is directed camera motion.

support.subject: As a creator, I can direct camera moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) instead of accepting whatever motion the model picks
